description: 4-point socket diagnostic (L-N, L-PE, N-PE, PE-to-radiator) migrated from VoltWatch v2.0-agnostic evaluateDiagnostics(). v1.1.0 changelog: original had an implicit catch-all that labeled ANY reading not matching the three named hazard conditions as 'VERIFIED CLEAN', including readings like lpe=200V/npe=15V that satisfy neither the floating-earth nor the clean-ground signature. v1.1.0 makes CLEAN an explicit, bounded condition and adds an INDETERMINATE terminal card for readings that match no known signature — see tests/fixtures/gap-case.json for the exact reading pattern that exposed this and tests/fixtures/{true-clean,floating-earth-clean-branch}.json for the fixtures proving the fix doesn't disturb correctly-classified cases.

verdict.title: LETHAL RISK: Electrified Plumbing Detected
verdict.description: Elevated AC voltage between socket earth and radiator/plumbing. A damaged appliance, boiler, or a bootleg ground somewhere in this or a neighboring flat is using the heating pipes as an electrical return path.
verdict.action: Do not touch radiators and appliances simultaneously. Disconnect any ground clamps tied to pipes. Notify building management immediately.

verdict.title: CRITICAL: Bootleg Ground ("Zanulēšana") Confirmed
verdict.description: Neutral terminal is jumpered directly to the socket earth clip. If the shared stairwell riser neutral ever burns off, all connected equipment chassis will sit at live mains voltage.
verdict.action: Kill power, open wall socket, cut out the internal jumper wire. Use a portable PRCD adapter for interim shock protection.

verdict.title: Floating Earth: SMPS Capacitive Voltage Divider
verdict.description: Earth pin is unconnected to building earth. Measured N-PE voltage is phantom capacitive voltage from connected power-supply Y-capacitors, not a true fault current path.
verdict.action: Plug all gear into one star-grounded power strip to equalize potential. Use a PRCD for safety and a USB/ground isolator to break audio hum loops.

verdict.title: Verified: Properly Earthed System (TN-S / TN-C-S)
verdict.description: Receptacle shows stable L-N and L-PE within nominal tolerance, with negligible N-PE offset and no plumbing bond leakage. Chassis leakage currents safely sink into earth.

verdict.title: Reading Pattern Does Not Match a Known Signature
verdict.description: This combination of L-N / L-PE / N-PE / radiator readings doesn't satisfy any known hazard or verified-clean signature in this fault-tree version. This is NOT a pass — it means the automated diagnosis is unable to classify the reading confidently.
verdict.action: Escalate to manual inspection by a qualified electrician. Do not record this as a verified-safe result.
